about.title: Aboot
about.intro: {project} is a neist-generation platform fur peer-tae-peer file sharin, biggit on modren decentralised technologie. It pits thegither an aisy-tae-uise interface wi a fully decentralised airchitecture, ensuirin sauf an reliable file sharin athoot the need fur a central authoritie. This project is open source, lowsed unner the {license}.

decentralized.title: Fully decentralised network
decentralized.description: Nae central server, nae single pynt o failure. Uisers find an doonload content straucht frae ithers, no relyin on ony central index, search engine, or database.

accessControl.title: Fine access control
accessControl.description: Onybodie can bigg thair ain network wi thair ain rules, fur free. Within ilka network, uiser roles is defined: ouner, admeenistrator, editor, moderator, an follaer. Ye hae fine control ower wha can publeesh, moderate, an doonload content.

ui.title: High qualitie interface
ui.description: A clean an snell media centre interface, designed fur desktop, TV, an mobile platforms. Aisy navigation wi keyboard, moose, gamepad, or remote. Pawkie uisers can rin the programme as a heidless server throu the command line interface.

dataFormat.title: Human-readable data format
dataFormat.description: The LISH data format is biggit on JSON, makin it aisy tae create, read, an unnerstaund. Share yer content wi clear an transparent metadata that onybodie can verifie.

security.title: Privacy an securitie
security.description: Aw peer-tae-peer communications is encrypit, ensuirin yer data bides preevat in transit. Uiser can hide ahint a VPN fur ekstra anonymitie. {project} respecks yer privacy bi design.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: The programme is available fur Windows, Linux, an macOS. Uise it on whitiver platform ye like best.

download.title: Doonload
download.description: Get {project} fur yer platform. Aw doonloads is free an open source.
